mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, we have clear skies and a temperature of 59 degrees at Military Ridge State Trail. The moon phase is Waxing Gibbous, and you can catch the ISS passing overhead at 6:37 PM, rising from the northwest near Verona High School and traveling toward the northeast near Home Depot. The overnight low will reach 50 degrees with no rain predicted.

City Hall reminds residents that municipal buildings will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27, and recycling collection will be pushed back to Friday. Additionally, the city is moving forward with plans to expand the Public Works and Utilities facility to better serve our growing population.

We have a full lineup of entertainment this week, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run and more music tomorrow at Lake Lou-ee and Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee on Tuesday, or visit The Bogey Factory for their trivia night next Wednesday.

In our weekly report, we are highlighting an incident from November 6, when officers were dispatched to a business on West Verona Avenue where a woman was found unresponsive in her vehicle and subsequently arrested for O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is the fan-favorite Really Reese's. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:30 PM tonight, so stop by soon for a scoop.
